:::note[このページについて]
[s1000d-writer-mcp](/s1000d-stack/ja/mcp/writer-mcp/) 0.6.0 の `tools/list` の応答から生成したページです。設定のしかたと応答の読み方は、s1000d-writer-mcp のページにあります。
:::

## 概要

下書き 1 件（説明・手順・プロセス・故障探求・パブリケーションモジュール）と採番の規則から、データモジュールを 1 件組み立てます。組み立てたあとに XSD・BREX・参照を検証し、`exact` の修正だけを最大 `maxFixRounds` 回（既定 3）まで自動で適用します。残った修正は `fixes[]` に候補付きで返します

## `tools/list` が返す説明

LLM が受け取る説明の原文（英語）です。

> Build ONE S1000D data module (descript / proced / process / fault) or publication module (pm) from a structured draft and number it from the allocation rules. You give titles, paragraphs, steps, tables, figures and references as a tree; the server writes the XML (you never write XML, DMCs, ICNs or the BREX reference). The XML is verified (XSD, BREX along the brexDmRef chain, references; applicability too when a product is given); fixes the server is certain about (confidence "exact") are applied automatically and verified again, up to maxFixRounds times. Returns xml, fileName, dmCode (pmCode for a pm), verification, appliedFixes[] (what was changed automatically), fixes[] (what remains: candidates to choose from), the updated ledger and the next ICN number. Writes into the CSDB only when write is true. A malformed draft comes back as error.code "input-error" with the path of the problem; a draft without applic is one (path "/applic"): the server does not decide applicability, so give at least applic.displayText.

The FIRST folder is also where write: true writes (it may not exist yet). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); other folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `write` | `boolean` |  | 既定値 `false` | Write the result into the CSDB (the first folder of csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR). Default false: the XML is only returned. Nothing is written when the XML is not valid against the XSD unless allowInvalid is true. |

| `maxFixes` | `integer` |  | 既定値 `50`、≥ 1、≤ 1000 | Cap on the remaining fixes listed in the response (default 50). |

| `issuePolicy` | `string` |  | `increment-issue` / `increment-inwork` / `keep`、既定値 `"increment-issue"` | When the CSDB already has the same data module and the draft gives no issueInfo: raise issueNumber (default), raise inWork, or keep the issue. |
| `assetFormats` | `object` |  |  | File format of each figure original, by assetId (or ICN): { extension: "PNG", notation: "png", publicId? }. Default: taken from the original file name for known formats (png, jpg, gif, svg, cgm, pdf). |
